Name: Disco Lewis Reskin
Author: djbassi
Description:
Just a quick mod I made to practice my pixel art a bit. Seemed a bit like low hanging fruit for a mod idea.

I used the Mayor Lewis outfit from Emily's 8-heart event (The Fashion Therapy scene) to let Lewis really express his inner self.

[b]Installation:[/b] Manually install by unzipping into Mods folder
[b]
Requires:[/b] SMAPI and Content Patcher.
